title: A citation is not proof of current authority
text: The supplied analysis warns that a cited artifact may still be outdated, inapplicable or incomplete. Persistent memory also needs correction and expiry. This is especially useful for answers about exceptions: finding a previous decision should trigger an applicability check rather than automatic reuse.
qualification: This is the corpus compiler’s analytical extension, not an independently evaluated vendor capability.
